name: Packages
insp: glass and gradient software launch and pricing pages
desc: Built on the firm's own promise of fixed fees. A live gradient mesh in the brand blues and greens flows behind raised, embossed package cards; the three real packages rise out of the surface, buttons press in when tapped, and each card flips over to compare every inclusion.
fx: Hand-written gradient mesh hero that bends toward your cursor, with a slow drifting mesh on phones
Headline splits in word by word
Package cards are raised, embossed panels on a shared surface that fly in from depth and press in when tapped
Compare everything is a pressed switch that flips the cards to the full lists, ticks drawing in one by one
The four service areas pin and expand one at a time, stacking upright on phones and portrait tablets
On phones the cards rise out of the surface in turn, headings lift line by line and words light up as you read
